title: Filter Notice
summary: Says how many items active filters hide and which filter hides what, so people don't think data is missing or bulk-act on a partial set.
description: Says how many items active filters hide, shows each filter as a removable chip with how many items it hides on its own, and warns when selected items are hidden.
catches: Items hidden by active filters, counted
Which filter hides the most, per chip
Selected items that are currently hidden
limits: Counts come from your props; it doesn't compute them
Per-filter counts are what each filter hides on its own, so they can add up to more than the total hidden
a11y: Filter chips are a labelled list; remove buttons name the filter
stops: Thought data was missing behind a filter
